name: Bishounen Punishment Show
original_name: 美少年パニッシュメントショー
source:
The buzzer sound, and the spotlights hit the stage.
The audience's attention is draw towards the stage.

"Ladies and gentlemen!"

"Thank you for waiting!"

"Let the spectacularly cruel and terrible show begin!"

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE247806.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
哨声响起，聚光灯打在舞台上。
观众的注意力被吸引到舞台上。

“女士们，先生们！”

“谢谢你久等了！”

“一场残酷而可怕的表演开始吧！”
